verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently verify Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, Ki cost, CaC availability, and mechanics. Preserve unresolved stamina, probability, and version-sensitive fields as null or descriptive text.
research_scope: Meteor Crash — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository commit coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent acquisition reports.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research commit for Meteor Crash was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 documentation classifies Meteor Crash as a Strike Super and states that it is obtainable for CaCs.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The current skill reference lists Parallel Quest 12 — Simian Battlefront as an acquisition route, while also documenting Meteor Crash as a starting skill for the close-up or mixed fighting styles. Both routes are preserved rather than collapsing them into a single unlock condition.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed documentation does not establish an Ultimate Finish requirement for the PQ12 route or starting-skill route.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The base documented Ki cost is 100. Holding the input continues the rush and consumes additional Ki, reaching slightly above 300 Ki in the documented behavior. Stamina cost remains null.

records.name: Meteor Crash
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 12 — Simian Battlefront; starting skill if Close Up or Mixed fighting style is selected
records.skill_description: A rapid rush of punches and kicks that continues while the input is held, consuming additional Ki for a longer sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes forward movement followed by repeated punches and kicks. Holding the skill button continues the rush until additional Ki is consumed, allowing the move to extend beyond its base activation. Exact hit counts and damage vary by target/version and are not promoted as canonical fixed values.
records.acquisition_notes: The canonical reference documents both PQ12 and the starting-skill route. Independent early-game reports also identify PQ12 as the route for players who did not start with the skill.
records.pve_notes: PQ12 farming may be required when the skill was not selected as a starting skill; exact random-drop behavior is not encoded as a fixed probability.
records.pvp_notes: Fast multi-hit Strike Super useful for extending hit counts; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
